author: Bender (port)
InertSteak (Pokermon)
description: 50 Gen 1 Pokemon Jokers ported from Pokermon by InertSteak (GPLv3), with evolution, now including the evolution stones. Level, scaling and stone evolutions use the Balatro3DS fork (Tier 1 SMODS.add_card / SMODS.destroy_joker, plus SMODS.ConsumableType for the stones' poke_item type) and need the fork build (github.com/sen2008/balatro3ds-fork); on the stock game the pack loads and plays as before, but nothing evolves and no stones appear. Energy does not exist on 3DS, so each Pokemon keeps its base effect at base values. The Fire, Water, Thunder and Moon Stones evolve Growlithe, Shellder, Pikachu, and Clefairy/Jigglypuff; since v1.3.0 a stone evolves the Joker you choose (Tier 3 target_joker), and the pack registers an Item Pack booster dealing stones (no wrapper art, so the engine's plain booster panel shows). The Leaf Stone is not included (none of its Gen 1 targets are in the pack).
name: Pokermon (3DS port)
